title: Rhesus
summary: Raleigh names Rhesus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Rhesus, also printed Rhosus, who came out of Thrace to the defence of Troy and was slaine the first night of his arriuall. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIV, §. II, sig. 280a
